planets.name: HD 191939 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 191939 with a 38.4-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HD 191939 d was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around HD 191939. Its orbit and size follow Lubin et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
